doc.name: preape
doc.instructions: Use PreApe before buying a RadarDEX token on Arc. Call preape_check first. If CAUTION or you need holders, call preape_analyze ($0.03 USDC on Base via x402). Verdicts: GO, CAUTION, AVOID. Missing data is null.

tools.name: preape_check
tools.description: Quick pre-trade risk check for a token on Arc / RadarDEX before buying. Returns GO, CAUTION, AVOID plus one-liner and red flags. Covers observed RadarDEX creator history and LP lock. Does not scan full holders. Use this first.

tools.name: preape_analyze
tools.description: Full pre-trade analysis for an Arc / RadarDEX token before buying. Returns GO / CAUTION / AVOID with creator observed launch history, LP lock, liquidity snapshot, and top-holder concentration. Volume and wash fields are null in v1. RadarDEX-only coverage.

includeHolders.description: Include Arcscan holder concentration. Default true.
